title: Synthesizing Chicken Noodle Soup From Pure Chemicals
summary: The Thought Emporium synthesizes chicken noodle soup from pure chemicals, following an original patent for artificial chicken flavor. The video explores how many chemicals it takes to make a convincing soup.
why: Brought up in threads on synthetic food and flavor as a fun example of building a dish from chemicals.
